notes: All strains are DA4201 (ilvA- MG1655 derivative, the study's parent) with plasmids. Empty-vector pCA24N -gfp + IPTG is the study's stated control (is_control true, inducer true). Phage insert plasmids (pORF1, recoded Svi3-3) labelled heterologous_expression with and without IPTG. M9 glucose without stated isoleucine -> amino_acids_supplied false. Temperature and aeration not stated.
